text: This staff report is about a matter for which the Community Council has delegated authority from City Council to make a final decision. This report provides information on applicable existing policies as they apply to the feasibility of providing 30 km/h speed limits on Local Roads in school areas under Scarborough Community Council's delegated authority. This report also discusses the Vision Zero Road Safety Plan, including steps being taken in regards to school age children.
Scarborough Community Council deferred consideration of the report (May 18, 2018) from the Director, Transportation Services, Scarborough District to the July 4, 2018 meeting to permit debate.
